name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.2 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 6 visits over 70 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2025-06-23, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.60 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
